rawstatus_disabled.title: Herpstat /RAWSTATUS is turned off
rawstatus_disabled.description:
The Herpstat at {host} stopped answering /RAWSTATUS, so Home Assistant can't read it. This usually happens after a firmware update resets the device's settings.

Open http://{host}/ in a browser, log in, go to **Admin**, tick **Show Advanced Status Integration Options**, then **Enable /RAWSTATUS Page**, and **Submit**. This message clears itself on the next successful update.
